select SUM(taxVat) taxVat, SUM(taxBuilding) taxBuilding, SUM(taxEducation)taxEducation, SUM(taxCorporate)taxCorporate, SUM(taxPersonal) taxPersonal from(
SELECT
IFNULL(IF(bs.balance_direction='DEBIT',SUM(IFNULL(bvr.debit,0)),SUM(IFNULL(bvr.credit,0))),0) taxVat, 0 taxBuilding, 0 taxEducation, 0 taxCorporate, 0 taxPersonal
0 taxVat, IFNULL(IF(bs.balance_direction='DEBIT',SUM(IFNULL(bvr.debit,0)),SUM(IFNULL(bvr.credit,0))),0) taxBuilding, 0 taxEducation, 0 taxCorporate, 0 taxPersonal
0 taxVat, 0 taxBuilding, IFNULL(IF(bs.balance_direction='DEBIT',SUM(IFNULL(bvr.debit,0)),SUM(IFNULL(bvr.credit,0))),0) taxEducation, 0 taxCorporate, 0 taxPersonal
0 taxVat, 0 taxBuilding, 0 taxEducation, IFNULL(IF(bs.balance_direction='DEBIT',SUM(IFNULL(bvr.debit,0)),SUM(IFNULL(bvr.credit,0))),0) taxCorporate, 0 taxPersonal
0 taxVat, 0 taxBuilding, 0 taxEducation, 0 taxCorporate, IFNULL(IF(bs.balance_direction='DEBIT',SUM(IFNULL(bvr.debit,0)),SUM(IFNULL(bvr.credit,0))),0) taxPersonal
from book_subject bs LEFT JOIN book_voucher_record bvr ON bvr.subject_id = bs.subject_id LEFT JOIN book_voucher bv ON bv.voucher_id = bvr.voucher_id where bvr.del_flag = '0' and bs.code like CONCAT((SELECT code from book_subject where subject_id = #{item.value}),'%') and bs.book_id = #{bookPeriod.bookId} and bv.year_period = #{bookPeriod.yearPeriod}
)a
